sources.title: alexkstern/nca-pre-pretraining-upstream - GitHub
sources.snippet: Both scripts call into src/language_train.py or src/openwebtext_pt.py and accept a --model_path / --model_file pointing to the NCA pre-pre-trained checkpoint. Set --reinit_modules embed none to re-initialize the embedding layers while retaining all other weights. These scripts can also be used for pre-pretraining on other datasets.
